tips: Q11 mein 8 mein se 6 chahiye — pehle 8 padhlo, phir jo 6 acche aate hain woh karo
Letter mein format galat ho gaya toh 2 marks pakka gaye — format ratto
Essay mein simple sentences likho — complex mein grammar galti ka risk
MCQ mein 2 options clearly wrong hote hain — eliminate karo
Note making mein abbreviations list ZAROOR likho — 1 mark milta hai
Poetry answers mein poet ka naam zaroor likho
Grammar: Do as Directed mein PURI rewritten sentence likhni hoti hai
Coorg = Coffee, Lencho = crooks, Kitty = Anne's diary — ye 3 MCQ guaranteed hain
Custard the Dragon ke characters yaad karo — Ink, Blink, Mustard, Custard
The Necklace — necklace fake nikla — irony yaad rakho (medium answer mein aata hai)

time_allocation.note: 15 min — passage dhyan se padho, MCQ aur note-making karo
35 min — note making 8 min, letter 10 min, essay 12 min, picture 5 min
15 min — fill blanks 7 min, do as directed 8 min
55 min — Q11 mein 6 choose karo wisely, Q14-16 ek ek carefully
10 min — format check, question numbers, spelling scan

targets.strategy: Section D MCQ (9 marks) + 3 prose short answers (6 marks) + Grammar fill blanks (4 marks) + Unseen MCQ (4-5 marks) = 25 marks
focus_areas: Grammar fill blanks — options se eliminate karo

targets.strategy: Reading (8) + Grammar (8) + Letter (3) + Essay (4) + D MCQ (9) + 5 short answers prose (10) + 1 medium answer (3)
All sections mein consistent performance. Reading full (10) + Grammar full (10) + Writing (12-14) + Textbooks (28-30)

exam_day_rules.timetable_source: mpbse.nic.in par official timetable available hoti hai.

answer_sheet_rules: partial_note: Letter format sahi + content thoda galat — phir bhi format ke marks milenge.
MCQ_method: MCQ mein sirf (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna — koi explanation nahi chahiye.
grammar_method: Do as Directed mein puri sentence likhni hoti hai — sirf changed part nahi likhna.

pen_rules.note: allowed: Blue aur Black pen pencil_use: Sirf rough work ke liye. Answers kabhi pencil se mat likho.
